These applications coming on for admission this day, th  the following:
 ORDER
Third bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant Mukesh Kumar Pawar.
His first bail application was dismissed on merit vide order dated 15.12.2021 passed in M.Cr.C. No.51951/2021.
His second bail application was for temporary bail on account of medical conditions of his wife.
He was released for a period of 15 days vide order dated 23.02.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.3440/2022.
First bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant Rahul Chahar.
Second bail application has been filed on behalf of applicant Archana Jaiswal.
Her first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 23.02.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No.6160/2022.

Applicants have been arrested in connection with Crime No.427/2021 of P.S. M.P. Nagar, Bhopal for the offence punishable under Section 409, 420 and 120-B of IPC and Section 6 of Madhya Pradesh Nicchepko ke Hiton ka Sangrakshan Adhiniyam.

sentences.text: Applicant Mukesh Kumar Pawar is in detention since 17.08.2021, Rahul Chahar is in detention since 06.07.2022 and Archana Jaiswal is in detention since 13.01.2022.

As per the prosecution case, the applicant and co-accused persons who were the director, managing director and employee/agents of the A.D.C. India Fishery Trading Company Pvt. Ltd. through their employee/agent collected huge amount from innocent persons assuring them to double their money Mukesh Kumar Pawar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163181272/

sentences.text: However, they did not pay the money even after the maturity period.
On the other hand, they closed down the company office and embezzled crores of rupees of the investors.
Thus, they cheated innocent people.

The specific allegations against the applicants Archana Jaiswal and Mukesh are that they were the directors of the company and Rahul Chahar was also on an important post of company and they all induced the innocent people to deposit money with the company and thus they usurped crores of rupees invested by the investors.
Learned counsel for the applicant Mukesh Kumar has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence and has falsely been implicated in the offence.
It is submitted that co-accused Devendra Jaiswal and Archana Jaiswal were the director of the said company.
He himself had deposited a sum of Rs. 12,00,000/- in the said company.
Amount has been embezzled by Devendra and Archana Jaiswal.

It is also the argument of learned counsel for Mukesh that before trial Court witnesses Rajendra Patidar (PW-1), Kanhaiyalal Ahirwar (PW-2), Kanhaiyalal Dhamore (PW-3) and Balram (PW-4) have been examined before the trial Court.
All the witnesses have made specific allegations against Devendra Jaiswal, Archana Jaiswal and others but they have not supported the prosecution case against the present applicants.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant-Mukesh Kumar be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the applicant Archana Jaiswal has submitted that main accused is her husband Devendra Jaiswal, who had floated fifth company.
She had been implicated only because she is is the wife of Devendra Jaiswal.
She had nothing to do with the commission of offence.
Mukesh Kumar has misappropriated an amount of Rs.2 crores as commission from the embezzled amount.
Devendra Jaiswal has moved an application under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act against her before the Family Court Bhopal and same is pending.
Therefore, she has nothing to do with the commission of offence.
Hence, it has been prayed that applicant-Archana Jaiswal be released on bail.
Learned counsel for the applicant Rahul Chahar has submitted that Rahul Chahar is an innocent person.
He was an agent.
He has not received any amount from Devendra Jaiswal.
He has been implicated only because he was the employee of the company.
Therefore, it has been prayed that applicant- accused-Rahul Chahar be released on bail.
A s far applicant Mukesh is concerned, his first bail application was dismissed on merit and thereafter there is no change in the circumstances.

The prayer for bail is made only on the ground that some of witnesses, who have been examined before the trail Court have not stated anything against him but have deposed only against Devendra Jaiswal and Archana Jaiswal, therefore, they be released on bail.

Such prayer is not worth acceptance as while considering the second bail application High Court is not expected to appreciate the evidence of witnesses examined before the trial Court as it is for the trial Court to appreciate the reliability and truthfulness of the evidence of the prosecution witnesses.
As far applicant - Archana Jaiswal is concerned, she is the director of the company.
She is wife of Devendra Jaiswal.
She has actively participated in the operation of the company.
Company has embezzled crores of rupees from the innocent investors.

Therefore, no case is made out to release Mukesh Kumar Pawar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/163181272/
3 her on bail.

sentences.text: Applicant Rahul Chahar is also among the main accused personss.
He was actively associated with the operation of the company as proprietor of the company.

In the case in hand, it cannot be overlooked that applicants in conspiracy and in connivance with co-accused Devendra Jaiswal and other co-accused persons played serious fraud upon innocent investors and deprived them of their hard earned money.
Sufficient evidence is available on record to connect all the applicants with the offence in question.
Applicants also induced the innocent people to deposit the money with the company.
They have embezzled crores of rupees cheated from the investors.

Therefore, without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case but having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, I am of the view that it is not a fit case for grant of bail.

Therefore, these bail applications filed on behalf of applicants-Archana Jaiswal,
Rahul Chahar and Mukesh Kumar are dismissed.
